---
title: "Möbius transformations revealed"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    css: styles.css
---

This interactive rebuild uses the Riemann sphere to show how Möbius transformations arise from simple motion in three dimensions. A colored square in the plane is lifted to the sphere by inverse stereographic projection, the sphere is moved, and the result is projected back to the plane.

```{ojs}
import {xySlider, mobiusRevealedThree} from "../../../components/mobiusRevealedThree.js";
```

::: {#mobius-revealed-explorer}
<button id="mobius-fullscreen-button" type="button" aria-label="Toggle fullscreen" title="Toggle fullscreen">⛶</button>

::: {.mobius-controls}
::: {.motion-controls}
```{ojs}
viewof sphereMotion = Inputs.form({
  phi: Inputs.range([0, Math.PI], {
    value: 0,
    step: 0.001,
    label: tex`\varphi`,
    format: value => value.toFixed(3)
  }),
  theta: Inputs.range([-Math.PI, Math.PI], {
    value: 0,
    // Decimal steps based at -PI can fail Firefox's native input validation.
    label: tex`\theta`,
    format: value => String(Math.max(-Math.PI, Math.min(Math.PI, +value.toFixed(3))))
  }),
  z: Inputs.range([-2, 3], {
    value: 0,
    step: 0.01,
    label: tex`z`,
    format: value => value.toFixed(2)
  }),
  showSphere: Inputs.toggle({
    value: false,
    label: "sphere"
  }),
  viewMode: Inputs.radio(["3D", "Plane"], {
    value: "Plane",
    label: "view"
  })
})
```
:::

::: {.xy-controls}
```{ojs}
viewof xy = xySlider({
  xmin: -6,
  xmax: 6,
  ymin: -6,
  ymax: 6,
  xstep: 0.02,
  ystep: 0.02,
  value: [0, 0],
  width: "180px",
  height: "180px"
})
```
:::
:::

::: {.mobius-scene-panel} 
```{ojs}
mobius_scene = mobiusRevealedThree()
```
:::
:::

::: {style="display: none"}
```{ojs}
phi = sphereMotion.phi
theta = sphereMotion.theta
z = sphereMotion.z
showSphere = sphereMotion.showSphere
viewMode = sphereMotion.viewMode
```

```{ojs}
mobius_scene.update({phi, theta, z, xy, showSphere, viewMode})
```
:::

```{ojs}
fullscreen_button = {
  const button = document.querySelector("#mobius-fullscreen-button");
  const explorer = document.querySelector("#mobius-revealed-explorer");
  const controller = new AbortController();

  function updateLabel() {
    const isFullscreen = document.fullscreenElement === explorer;
    button.textContent = isFullscreen ? "×" : "⛶";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", isFullscreen ? "Exit fullscreen" : "Enter fullscreen");
    button.setAttribute("title", isFullscreen ? "Exit fullscreen" : "Enter fullscreen");
  }

  button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement === explorer) {
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    } else {
      await explorer.requestFullscreen();
    }
    updateLabel();
  }, {signal: controller.signal});

  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", updateLabel, {signal: controller.signal});
  updateLabel();
  invalidation.then(() => controller.abort());
  undefined
}
```
